articles.description: Anthropic started just five years ago an is now one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.

key_points: Anthropic is poised to hit a value of more than $1.4 trillion (£1.1 trillion) when it debuts on the public stock market.
The artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the popular chatbot Claude said it will price shares at $83 each when it lists on Thursday on the Nasdaq, a tech-focused stock exchange based in New…
That price will make it one of the most highly valued companies in the world.

articles.title: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
articles.description: The AI company behind Claude is about to sell its shares on the US stock market - making its founders very rich.
articles.summary: Brother and sister Dario and Daniela Amodei are chief executive and president of Anthropic In the space of just five years, Anthropic has gone from unknown start-up to tech giant, worth more than a trillion dollars.
key_points: The company behind the AI platform Claude was formed by seven people who left rival OpenAI in 2021 and, in a matter of hours, will become multi-billionaires - on paper at least.

If they go for the highest price, the founders' shareholdings will be worth at least $18.5bn each.
